operators.customDisplayName: Load full NOAA monthly wildfire stats from data/wildfire/input/noaa_wildfires_monthly_stats.csv, skipping 3 metadata lines so the header row is Date, Acres Burned, Number of Fires, Acres Burned per Fire

operatorProperties.code:
def process(nifc):
    import pandas as pd
    df = nifc.copy()
    # keep digits only (some values have leading '*' etc.)
    for c in ['Fires','Acres']:
        df[c] = (df[c].astype(str)
                     .str.replace(r'[^0-9]', '', regex=True))
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').astype('Int64')
    df = df.dropna(subset=['Year','Fires','Acres']).copy()
    df['Year'] = df['Year'].astype('int64')
    df['Fires'] = df['Fires'].astype('int64')
    df['Acres'] = df['Acres'].astype('int64')
    return df.sort_values('Year').reset_index(drop=True)

operators.customDisplayName: Clean NIFC annual data by stripping non-digits from Fires/Acres (handles leading '*' etc.), converting to int, dropping rows with missing values, and sorting by Year
Aggregate NOAA monthly wildfire stats to annual totals: Year=Date//100, sum Number of Fires as noaa_fires and Acres Burned as noaa_acres

operatorProperties.code:
def process(nifc_clean, noaa_annual) -> pd.DataFrame:
    import pandas as pd
    df = nifc_clean.merge(noaa_annual, on='Year', how='inner')
    df = df.rename(columns={'Fires':'nifc_fires','Acres':'nifc_acres'})
    df['diff_fires'] = df['noaa_fires'] - df['nifc_fires']
    df['diff_acres'] = df['noaa_acres'] - df['nifc_acres']
    return df[['Year','nifc_fires','noaa_fires','diff_fires','nifc_acres','noaa_acres','diff_acres']].sort_values('Year')
